visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a golden-brown, crispy shrimp ball held by wooden chopsticks. The texture shows thin potato shreds and orange carrot bits. Bright, even studio lighting emphasizes the glistening surface. In the background, other shrimp balls are blurred on a blue textured plate. (2) A chef wearing a white jacket and transparent gloves holds a large glass bowl filled with finely shredded white potatoes. The setting is a clean, modern kitchen studio. The chef uses chopsticks to lift and show the texture of the potato shreds. (3) The shredded potatoes are submerged in a pot of boiling water on a stove. The water is bubbling slightly. The camera captures the motion of the water and the change in the potatoes' appearance as they are blanched. Lighting is bright and functional. (4) A metal strainer is lifted from the pot, filled with the blanched potato shreds. Water drips through the mesh back into the pot. The background shows a dark stovetop surface. (5) In a clean glass bowl, the blanched potato shreds are combined with vibrant orange carrot slivers, a raw yellow egg, and white powdered seasonings. The chef's gloved hands are visible at the edges of the frame, preparing to mix. (6) The chef's hand, covered in a clear plastic glove, thoroughly mixes the potato, carrot, and egg mixture. The texture becomes more cohesive and slightly translucent. The background is a light wood-grain countertop. (7) Light-colored flour is sprinkled into the bowl from a small glass container. Subsequently, grayish-purple raw shrimp pieces are added. The chef continues to incorporate all ingredients together using a hand-kneading motion. (8) The chef uses both hands to roll the seasoned mixture into uniform, spherical balls about the size of a golf ball. These balls are then placed onto a white parchment-lined metal baking tray. (9) The metal tray filled with the shaped shrimp balls is slid into a stainless steel oven. The interior of the oven is illuminated with a warm light, revealing the heating elements and the texture of the food. (10) A small glass bowl is shown top-down. Dark soy sauce is poured from a bottle, followed by spoonfuls of pale garlic paste, dark vinegar, and white sugar. Sesame seeds are sprinkled on top and stirred with a spoon. (11) The finished crispy shrimp balls are arranged neatly on a blue ceramic plate with a ridged border. A final close-up shows one ball being lifted with chopsticks, revealing its cooked, crispy exterior.
